notes.title: WLB Version 1.0.1 is live
notes.notes:
Hi everyone!

First off, thanks for downloading What's Left Behind.

Version 1.0.1 is here and it's mostly just bug fixes for things that managed to sneak out the door with version 1.0. Of course, if you find any bugs left over, please let me know so that I can fix them ASAP.

Change Log v. 1.0.1

 Fixed a bug that caused upgrades to stall if changing menus while they were running
 Fixed a bug that kept player from being able to research Standardized Crating
 Fixed a bug that caused Resource Overlays to become stuck visible
 Fixed a bug where player could not complete "Build a..." objectives
 Fixed a bug where settlers were not visible
 Fixed a bug that prevented monuments from saving properly
 Fixed a bug that prevented player-built structures from loading properly when a saved game was loaded
 Changed camera idle animation so that when player returns to play the camera will now snap back to last position
